title: Camp features
description: What a camp offers: facilities, activities, accommodation attributes, and program models (multi-valued on camp.features). ONE namespace holds both widely-shared features and long-tail differentiators, so a rare draw like land sailing is as filterable as a dining hall. Each term may carry `category` (what kind of thing it is), `broader` (a coarser parent, so specific leaves answer general queries), and `aliases` (synonyms absorbed during curation, not valid data values). Seeded from camp-finder.

terms.label: Air Conditioning
terms.description: Air conditioning in a main building such as the dining hall.

terms.label: Alpine Tower
terms.description: A multi-face alpine tower, distinct from a standard climbing wall or tower.

terms.label: Aquatics
terms.description: Water-based program of any kind; parent term for specific aquatics activities.

terms.label: Archery
terms.description: Archery range and instruction.

terms.label: ATV Program
terms.description: An all-terrain-vehicle riding program.

terms.label: Bathhouse
terms.description: Shower house with hot water.

terms.label: BB Guns
terms.description: BB-gun range, typically for Cub Scout-age youth.

terms.label: Bike Park
terms.description: A purpose-built pump track, BMX circuit, or skills park.

terms.label: Black Powder
terms.description: Muzzle-loading rifle program.

terms.label: Blacksmithing
terms.description: A working forge with instruction.

terms.label: Boat Access Only
terms.description: The property is reached by boat; there is no road access.

terms.label: Cabins
terms.description: Enclosed cabin lodging.

terms.label: Campsite Electricity

terms.label: Canoeing

terms.label: Climbing Tower

terms.label: COPE

terms.label: Dining Hall

terms.label: Horseback Riding

terms.label: Kayaking
terms.description: Kayaking program.

terms.label: Land Sailing

terms.label: Living History

terms.label: Marine Science

terms.label: Rifle

terms.label: Sailing
